summary: Tested the buyer portal end to end, on the backend and in the UI. Backend: 15 of 16 new pytest checks pass (tests/test_v190_buyer_portal.py). These pass: register validation (422 for missing city, bad city, bad country; 409 for duplicate email); staff login before email confirmation gives 403; approving before confirmation gives 409; verify-email (bad token and wrong-type token give 400); pending whoami and dashboard; unverified buyer invite gives 403; admin approve gives signin_status self_registered, links the tenant and sends the 'verified' notification; profile PUT to masters (422 for bad city), avatar validation, change password (400 for wrong current password); team invite gives pending, duplicate gives 409, admin approve gives sent, approving twice gives 409; colleague has is_org_admin false and gets 403 on invite and remove; admin add buyer (422 / 200 / 409) and set-password then login; cross-org remove gives 404, self remove gives 400; RBAC (buyer gets 403 on /buyer/admin/*, /buyer-applications and /market/admin/settings; admin gets 403 on /buyer/me); outbid, order-placed and dispatched notifications; dashboard leading/outbid status, to_pay, in_delivery, payments; fee fields hidden; buyer B cannot mark A's order received or read A's notification; read and read-all; removing a colleague sets is_active false, /buyer/me then gives 403 and login is blocked. FAILED: a removed colleague's existing session can still bid on the marketplace (security). Also confirmed by a probe: the register rate limit can be bypassed by setting a spoofed X-Forwarded-For header. The iteration 189 Administrator-card bug for buyers is fixed (403 'cannot sign in to the admin console'). UI: these all work: login Buyer organisation card with 'Register as a buyer — free' linking to /buyers/register; the Forgot password buyer option; the public 'Register as buyer' button; the verify-email page (ok and bad token); pending buyer login landing on /buyer with the banner, the team read-only message and market-who-pending; the verified buyer tiles, bids (LEADING), orders (Pay button, delivery status, I received it), payments and refunds, notifications (mark read and read all update the bell count), the avatar menu with 4 items, profile save and persistence, the change-password error and success toasts, the forgot link, team invite (WAITING FOR PMC), the public buyer menu (My dashboard, My bids & purchases, Sign out), and the /buyer redirect to login after sign out; admin team approve, admin approve of a self-registered app, and admin add buyer; vendor Mark dispatched and Mark delivered. Bugs found: STORED XSS in buyer notifications; city dropdown ghost entries and race (admin add buyer failed with 422); a misleading warning toast when approving a self-registered app.

critical.issue: A colleague removed by the org admin (is_active=false) can still bid, offer and buy with their existing session: the bid returned 200 and top_bid was 500, and whoami still says verified true. Cause: security.current_admin and marketplace._bidder and whoami never check user.is_active. Only buyer_portal.current_buyer checks it.

critical.endpoint: notify_bidder / notify_user bodies (marketplace.set_delivery note, listing title in outbid/order/payment messages, buyer_portal invite/registration notify_role bodies)
critical.issue: Seller-controlled text (delivery note, up to 300 chars, never reviewed by PMC; listing title) is put into the HTML body without escaping. BuyerPortalE then renders it with dangerouslySetInnerHTML. Confirmed: note 'AWB ' ran JavaScript in the buyer's /buyer/notifications page (window.__xss === 1). The same HTML also goes into the emails. Fix: html.escape() every interpolated user value on the backend (title, note, names, org names, emails), and/or sanitise on the frontend (e.g. DOMPurify) or render as text.

minor.issue: The rate-limit IP is taken from the first X-Forwarded-For value, which the client controls. A request with 'X-Forwarded-For: 9.9.9.9' was stored with ip 9.9.9.9, so the 5/hour limit can be bypassed. Use the last trusted proxy hop or request.client.
The seller can move delivery_status back from 'received' (confirmed by the buyer) to dispatched or delivered. There is no state-machine guard.
A pending (unapproved) buyer has no tenant, so the Members list is empty and does not even show themselves.
Stripe success/cancel URLs go to /market/purchases, not /buyer/orders. The buyer portal Orders page's ?order= handler is never reached after checkout.

ui_bugs.component: BuyerProfileFields city dropdown (register, profile, admin add buyer)
ui_bugs.issue: Two causes. (1) Race: when a country is selected, cities are fetched for the whole country (limit 500) before the states list has loaded. That stale response fills the city select with 500 cities while the label says 'Choose a state first'. useList has no abort or stale-response guard. (2) Duplicate React keys (`${state_code}-${name}`): masters has 2 entries each for UP-Akbarpur and OR-Bargarh, and the console shows the 'two children with the same key' error. Ghost options stay after the state changes, so Andaman & Nicobar showed Akbarpur and Bargarh. Picking one gives 422 'Please choose a city from the list'. Reproduced in Admin → Add a buyer directly, where the save failed. Fix: ignore stale responses (AbortController / request id), wait for states to load before fetching cities, and dedupe cities or use a unique key.

Approving a self-registered app shows a warning toast: '... already has another PMC sign-in — send the buyer sign-in to a different email'. The backend correctly returned signin_status 'self_registered'. The frontend treats any non-'sent' status as email_in_use (BuyerAppsTab.jsx line ~23). It should show a success toast like 'Approved · buyer notified'.

issues: A floating EN language widget in the bottom-left overlaps the sidebar 'Your PMC desk' box (pending page screenshot). There is also a second EN switcher in the header.
Toasts at the top-right cover the 'Mark all read' button on Notifications.
The bottom of the sidebar desk box is cut off at 1080p.

action_items: CRITICAL: Escape every user-supplied value put into notification and email HTML bodies (html.escape), especially set_delivery note and listing titles. Also stop rendering n.body with raw dangerouslySetInnerHTML in BuyerPortalE Notifications (sanitise or render as text).

CRITICAL: Block deactivated users everywhere. Add an is_active check to security.current_admin, or at least to marketplace._bidder and whoami, so a removed colleague's live session cannot bid, offer, buy or pay. Consider bumping a token generation on removal.
HIGH: Fix the city dropdown race and duplicate keys in BuyerProfileFields (stale-response guard; fetch cities only after states have loaded; dedupe or unique key).
MEDIUM: BuyerAppsTab: handle signin_status 'self_registered' with a success toast.
MINOR: Base the register rate-limit IP on a trusted hop, not a spoofable first X-Forwarded-For value.
MINOR: Block seller delivery-status regressions after the buyer marks received.
MINOR: Point Stripe success_url to /buyer/orders?order= for buyer sessions.
critical_code_review_comments: security.current_admin ignores is_active. Any deactivated admin_users session keeps working app-wide until the token expires, not only for buyers.

marketplace and buyer_portal f-string HTML bodies have no escaping. vendor_confirm and notify_role emails carry the same injection to admins (invite name, org_name, contact_name come from user input).
useList in BuyerProfileFields has no cleanup or abort, so out-of-order responses overwrite state.
verify-email tokens can be reused (idempotent), which is acceptable; they expire after 3 days.

success_rate.frontend: ~88% (core flows pass; XSS, city dropdown and approve-toast bugs)

seed_data_creation: All test data was created with test_*@example.com / TEST_ prefixes and deleted afterwards by id or email: admin_users, buyer_applications, tenants, buyer_team_requests, notifications, mkt_listings, mkt_bids and mkt_orders. 16 admin notify_role notifications (subjects naming TEST orgs) were also deleted. No seed data was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_v190_buyer_portal.py -n 0 -v. It registers 1 buyer through the public API (rate limit is 5/hour/IP, counted from buyer_applications), mints the buyer_verify and pwd_reset JWTs from backend/.env, inserts live mkt_listings for testvendor directly, and cleans up after itself. Use lowercase emails (the backend lowercases them). For UI: 'python tests/v190_ui_setup.py create' writes /tmp/v190.json (a = verified buyer, p = pending buyer, verify_token, listings, o1 paid+dispatched with an XSS probe note, o2 awaiting payment). After the change-password test the buyer password is Newpass@123. 'clean' deletes everything. Retest: test_16 (removed colleague bid), the XSS probe (window.__xss on /buyer/notifications), admin add buyer with a state selected, and the self-register approve toast.
rca of the issue:
XSS: marketplace.set_delivery puts body.note into '

...{body.note}

', and notify_user stores that HTML. BuyerPortalE Notifications renders it with dangerouslySetInnerHTML, so it runs in the buyer's page. Removed-colleague bid: buyer_portal.remove sets is_active=false, but marketplace._bidder uses security.current_admin, which only loads the user and never checks is_active; the tenant is still active, so the bid is accepted. City dropdown: on country change, states=[] so needState is false and a country-wide cities fetch starts. Then states load, the url becomes null and rows are set to []. The slow fetch then resolves and sets 500 rows. Duplicate keys (UP-Akbarpur x2, OR-Bargarh x2) leave orphan
